observations: Photo 0 shows a white industrial manual sewing machine from a top-side angle. It has a large metal balance wheel, a needle bar, presser foot, and various knobs and levers. A small circular metal plate is visible near the front, but the text is not legible.

Photo 1 shows the same machine from a side angle, with hands guiding fabric under the needle. The machine is actively sewing, with thread visible. The brand name 'MAYFAIR' is visible on the side of the machine body in photo 1.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some minor surface marks and wear, especially on the metal parts. The white paint is mostly intact.
The machine is manual, operated by a hand-cranked balance wheel, not electric. No motor or power cord is visible.

risks.risk: The machine may not be fully functional or may have internal wear (e.g., needle bar, feed dogs, or gear damage) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up video of the machine being operated, showing smooth rotation of the balance wheel, needle movement, and thread tension without skipping or jamming.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly not working or requiring repair

risks.risk: Missing parts such as the foot pedal (if it has one), extra needles, or accessories that may be necessary for full use.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories and parts laid out, or a video demonstrating the machine's full operation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete or missing accessories

risks.risk: The machine may have hidden damage or rust inside the casing, especially around the needle area or bobbin case.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the bobbin case, needle plate, and feed dogs, showing no rust, cracks, or debris.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or requiring cleaning

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the bobbin case and needle plate to check for rust or damage.
A video of the machine being operated to confirm smooth function and stitching quality.
A photo showing all included accessories and parts.
A clear photo of the brand plate or model number if available.
